populationScope.fr: Population de la France métropolitaine dans ses frontières contemporaines selon RCS, Corse et Alsace-Lorraine comprises ; Algérie et territoires ultramarins exclus. Contour de référence Natural Earth.
populationScope.en: Population of metropolitan France within the present-day borders specified by RCS, including Corsica and Alsace-Lorraine, excluding Algeria and overseas territories. Natural Earth reference outline.

mappings.reviewNote: 1918–1961 and 1962–2015: present-day borders of metropole only. Pinned Natural Earth FRA polygons 0 (Corsica), 1 (mainland), 2 (Oléron); all overseas polygons excluded.

populationScope.fr: Population du périmètre RCS pour la Chine de 1999 à 2015, Hong Kong, Macao et Tibet compris, Taïwan exclu ; union des contours de référence CHN, HKG et MAC de Natural Earth.
populationScope.en: Population within the RCS China scope for 1999–2015, including Hong Kong, Macao and Tibet, excluding Taiwan; combined Natural Earth CHN, HKG and MAC reference outlines.

mappings.reviewNote: 1999–2015: present-day borders; incl. Hong Kong, Macau, Tibet. CHN alone would omit two explicitly included territories.

populationScope.fr: Population du périmètre RCS pour l’Inde depuis 1947, Sikkim et anciennes colonies françaises et portugaises compris ; Pakistan, Bangladesh et Birmanie exclus. Contour de référence généralisé Natural Earth.
populationScope.en: Population within the RCS India scope from 1947, including Sikkim and former French and Portuguese colonies, excluding Pakistan, Bangladesh and Burma. Generalized Natural Earth reference outline.

mappings.reviewNote: 1947–2015: present-day borders; not incl. Pakistan, Bangladesh, Burma; also incl. Sikkim, Portuguese and French Indian colonies. Reference outline does not adjudicate disputed boundaries.

populationScope.fr: Population de la Fédération de Russie dans le périmètre RCS de 1991 à 2015, Crimée exclue. Le polygone criméen du contour Natural Earth est explicitement retiré.
populationScope.en: Population of the Russian Federation within the RCS 1991–2015 scope, excluding Crimea. The Crimean polygon in the Natural Earth outline is explicitly removed.

mappings.reviewNote: 1991–2015: present-day borders of Russian Federation only; not incl. Crimea. Pinned Natural Earth RUS polygon 100 bounds [32.508008,44.387598,36.575,46.219573] represents Crimea and is excluded.

populationScope.fr: Population des États-Unis continentaux, de l’Alaska et d’Hawaï dans le périmètre RCS depuis 1898, populations autochtones comprises ; dépendances exclues. Contour contemporain Natural Earth.
populationScope.en: Population of the continental United States, Alaska and Hawaii within the RCS scope from 1898, including Native Americans, excluding dependencies. Modern Natural Earth outline.

mappings.reviewNote: 1898–2015: combined present-day CONUS, Alaska, Hawaii (including Native Americans).

populationScope.fr: Population du Brésil dans les frontières contemporaines définies par RCS depuis 1903, Acre compris ; contour de référence Natural Earth.
populationScope.en: Population of Brazil within the present-day borders defined by RCS from 1903, including Acre; Natural Earth reference outline.

mappings.reviewNote: 1903–2015: present-day borders; incl. Acré.

populationScope.fr: Population de l’Angleterre, du pays de Galles, de l’Écosse et de l’Irlande du Nord dans le périmètre RCS depuis 1921 ; île de Man, îles Anglo-Normandes et République d’Irlande exclues. Contour Natural Earth.
populationScope.en: Population of England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland within the RCS scope from 1921, excluding the Isle of Man, Channel Islands and Republic of Ireland. Natural Earth outline.

mappings.reviewNote: 1921–2015: combined present-day borders of England, Wales, Scotland, Northern Ireland; not incl. Isle of Man, Channel Islands, Republic of Ireland.

populationScope.fr: Population de l’Indonésie dans le périmètre RCS de 2002 à 2015, Nouvelle-Guinée occidentale comprise, Timor oriental exclu ; contour de référence Natural Earth.
populationScope.en: Population of Indonesia within the RCS 2002–2015 scope, including Western New Guinea, excluding East Timor; Natural Earth reference outline.

mappings.reviewNote: 2002–2015: present-day borders; incl. West Irian; not incl. East Timor.

populationScope.fr: Population du Nigéria dans ses frontières de l’époque selon RCS ; seuls 2009–2015 sont retenus, après le transfert de Bakassi au Cameroun en 2008. Contour de référence Natural Earth.
populationScope.en: Population of Nigeria within its contemporary boundaries according to RCS; only 2009–2015 is retained, after the 2008 transfer of Bakassi to Cameroon. Natural Earth reference outline.

mappings.reviewNote: 1960–2015: contemporaneous borders. Retain only years after the 14 August 2008 Bakassi authority transfer, documented by the United Nations.
